title: BlueLinx Introduces TruExterior® Siding and Trim by Westlake Royal Building Products™
summary: Launches Poly-Ash Siding and Trim Across Select BlueLinx Markets BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC), a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of building products, today announced the launch of TruExterior ® Siding and Trim by Westlake Royal Building Products™ across 12 BlueLinx markets, including six of the top 50 U.S. metropolitan statistical areas. This coordinated expansion significantly broadens access to TruExterior’s high‑performance poly‑ash siding and trim, reinforcing BlueLinx’s commitment to growing its specialty product portfolio in key, high‑demand regions. TruExterior Siding and Trim is now available through BlueLinx locations in Denville, NJ; Pittsburgh, PA; Frederick, MD; Richmond, VA; Raleigh, NC; Charlotte, NC; Statesville, NC; Charleston, SC; Atlanta, GA; Tampa, FL; Jacksonville, FL; and Nashville, TN.
